about: Findings axe-pages.mjs accepts, each with its reason. id is an axe rule or a probe (skip-link, h1, lang, focus-visible, focus-obscured, target-size, reflow); page narrows it to pages whose name contains it; target to nodes whose selector contains it. Keep in step with the known limitations on the accessibility statement.

allow.reason: Example: a page with one form and no blocks repeated across pages.
